title: trond inspect output
description:
Returned by `trond inspect [node]`, `trond inspect --network

`, or `trond inspect --all`. Manifest of endpoints and runtime info usable as test-harness fixtures.

container_ip.description: Internal docker network IP of the container; absent for jar runtime.

container_id.description: Full 64-hex docker container ID (best-effort, local docker nodes only).

logs.description: Runtime-discriminated log locator (same shape as `trond status` -o json). docker: read `path` inside `container` via `docker exec`; jar: read the systemd `unit`'s journal.

intent_hash.description: Versioned hash of the last applied intent (v2:<sha256>, legacy bare 64-hex accepted). Same value `trond status` reports; lets a harness detect config drift between manifest refreshes.

build_cache_key.description: Content-addressed build cache key (source-built nodes only).

build_revision.description: Resolved source git revision (short) the node was built from (source-built nodes only).

monitoring.description: Prometheus + Grafana stack ports for nodes deployed with --monitor. Host is implicit: 127.0.0.1 for local targets, target.host for SSH.

prometheus_port.description: Host port the Prometheus container is bound to. 0 means Prometheus is reachable only inside the docker network (not exposed).

grafana_port.description: Host port the Grafana container is bound to.
